messages:
elena: Thanks for joining today — dropping the Q&A thread for anything we didn't cover in the all-hands. Post strategic questions about mission, positioning, market, competitors. I'll jump in as we go. (Recording + slides in #all-hands link)

sam: Quick note — I'll monitor questions about runtime and product roadmap.

devon: when's the public docs for Dedicated pricing? paging @ops-rev
mica: curious how we're telling customers we're different than 'BigCloud AI' — is it cost, control, or performance?
akash: for eng folks: do we have baseline numbers vs. open LLMs on 8k context? especially p99 latency on T4 vs A100?
frank: from GTM — are we shifting more ARR focus to Dedicated/Private in 2026? wanted rough % targets if public
elena: Short answers: Dedicated/Private expansion is priority for sales-assisted deals; goal: 30% of new logo ACV from Dedicated/Private this fiscal. Messaging: "serving-first economics" — cost+reliability+deploy flexibility. Will post a short blurb.
devon: any change to self-serve hosted free tier thresholds? customer feedback is hitting rate limits early.
elena: No change planned this quarter; product is evaluating smarter quotas + onboarding credits.
mica: what's our short elevator pitch vs competitors (2 lines)?
elena: "Redwood Inference: same API across hosted, dedicated, and private — predictable latency and unit economics at scale." keep it tightly tied to SLOs and rollout tooling.
sam: technical: for benchmarks, akash — can you share the perf doc link? also note quantization profiles matter.
akash: putting a perf snapshot in here:
```
Model: Llama-2 13B
HW: T4 x2
seq=2048
p50=45ms p95=120ms p99=250ms
```
frank: any guidance for reps on competing against hyperscalers on price? do we have a 'walk away' price floor?
mica: also: do we lean into partnerships vs direct competition in enterprise? sounds like channel strategy question.
elena: Reps: lead with differentiation (SLA, private deployment, rollout controls). We'll publish competitive docs next week with price ranges and "walk-away" guidance. Partnerships: yes — marketplace + strategic SI partners in regulated industries.
ops-bot: Meeting recording uploaded: https://redwood/ah/rec/1834567890
devon: follow-up: can leadership share the roadmap doc link for canary/rollback features?
elena: will drop links and a short FAQ in this thread by EOD. Thanks for the great questions :raised_hands:

mica: :thumbsup:
akash: thanks!
frank: will sync with sales ops tomorrow.
